clips.title: The story
paras: At the Dragonmaw Gates, heavy fortifications bar the road climbing from the eastern Wetlands. They guard the ascent to Grim Batol, a mountain fortress in the cursed dwarven ruins.

Carved into rugged peaks along the eastern Wetlands, the Dragonmaw Gates seal the winding road to Grim Batol. The barriers take their name from the Dragonmaw orcs, who held the dwarven mountain city during the Second War. The road remains a fortified checkpoint, and the ascent still brings danger. Powerful drakes haunt the pass, while grim reminders of the clan's dark history linger in the mountains.

The Dragonmaw orcs were broken and scattered after the Demon Soul was destroyed, but the mountain path remains dangerous. Powerful red dragons have been seen watching the winding slopes and perches around the gates. Monstrous drakes and Dragonmaw remnants still lurk in the nearby hills, and the gates remain a firm barrier against travelers bold enough to venture into the heights.
